systems.system: PATNUC broadband connectivity of public entities (Component 2)
systems.country_label: Connectivité large bande de certaines entités publiques dans le cadre du PATNUC
systems.owner: MINPOSTEL, PATNUC project management unit; World Bank loan IDA 69870-CM
systems.tiers: decentralised local authorities (CTD), hospitals and health centres, schools, training and social centres; identification centres named among the entities to be connected

note: A call for expressions of interest for a study of bandwidth and LAN needs; it names the digitalisation of civil status only as one of the public services the connectivity is meant to serve, and describes no civil registration system.
